headline: Sep 9 · The $200 V2 tranche is at its halfway mark — day 5 of 10, $66.67 spent — and has bought one attributable lead. The two real ones sit untouched outside Frankie's licensed states, and the third is still lost behind a lead form nobody connected to the sheet. Day 10 is a decision date being funded with data the funnel isn't capturing.

spotlight.title: Half the tranche is gone and it is still buying out-of-area leads
spotlight.detail: V2 is day 5 of 10 with $66.67 of $200 spent ($2.07 yesterday, lifetime $309.36) — and both real leads it has produced, Nadine Dickens (TX, "NO ONE CAN") and Linda Hansink (WA, "OUT OF LICENSED AREA"), are in states you cannot write in. Neither has been referred out or dropped in writing. Narrow the form/campaign geo to your licensed states today: every dollar past this point buys the same unusable lead, and the day-10 verdict on this tranche is only as honest as the map it was pointed at.

spotlight.title: The missing lead is a form-to-sheet mapping, not an n8n outage — that is a small fix
spotlight.detail: The 19:07Z watchdog run narrowed it: n8n's W1 Lead Ingest DID execute successfully around the Sep 6 "Gap math new" lead — no crash. So the lead was never handed to it. The V3 lead form is almost certainly not subscribed to the "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Google Sheet. Connect the form, then prove it with one real submit end-to-end. Until that closes, Meta counts 3 leads since Sep 5 and the inbox has 2 — you cannot report a cost per lead you cannot count.

spotlight.title: Compliance 0/7 on day 10 of live dialing — and now it has names
spotlight.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license # disclosure) are still open, unchanged since Aug 27 when the first real consumer lead landed. Two named people are now sitting behind that gate while every notification the system sends says "call fast." Spend is trivial right now ($2.07 yesterday) — this is the cheapest window you will ever get to close the gates or put the one-line rule in writing about who may be dialed and by whom.

blockers.label: Geo — campaign points at the wrong map
blockers.detail: Both real V2 leads out of licensed area (Nadine Dickens TX, Linda Hansink WA). Re-target the form/campaign to licensed states, and decide refer-out-or-drop on both in writing before any contact.

blockers.label: V3 form not wired to the sheet
blockers.detail: n8n ran fine — the Sep 6 "Gap math new" lead never reached it. Subscribe the V3 lead form to the "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Sheet / capture webhook and verify with one live submit. 3 Meta leads vs 2 inbox emails since Sep 5.

blockers.label: Compliance 0/7
blockers.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration, $200 + $10K bond) and b7 (CA producer license #, Cal Ins Code 1725.5(c)) still open on day 10 of live dialing, with two real names in the funnel.

blockers.label: Day-10 decision has no measurement behind it
blockers.detail: V2 closes at $200 / Sep 15. Booked calls from real ad leads: still zero measured — the CRM sync has been down since Aug 27 and the lead count is disputed between Meta, the inbox and the digest. Decide now what evidence would count as "keep going".

blockers.label: Founder mailbox silent 12 days
blockers.detail: No manifestdestiny247 mail since Aug 28, though Frankie is clearly active in Ads Manager (paused "8 doors" during ad edits Sep 7). Decisions are happening in-tool with no written trail.

blockers.label: Autonomous lane wrote nothing again
blockers.detail: The cofounder sweep fired on-cron at 00:33Z today but cofounder_log.json is still Sep 7 — fired-but-did-not-write, the exact bridge signature. index.html frozen at v15.17 (12 days); meeting_brief_lines.json still Aug 20 (20 days). Rebuild both as LOCAL tasks.

blockers.label: EIN
blockers.detail: ~73 days silent since the Jun 28 re-fax. IRS 1-202-488-3100, RedFax 510-497-1224 — 8–11 AM PT window.

tasks.lead: Narrow the $300 campaign geo to your licensed states
tasks.detail: Two-for-two real leads landed out of area. Half the tranche is already spent buying them. Fix the targeting before the second half goes the same way.

tasks.lead: Refer-out-or-drop Nadine Dickens (TX) + Linda Hansink (WA) — in writing
tasks.detail: Both real, both unworkable as-is, both still untouched two days on. Write the decision down before anyone dials; do not call first and ask later.

tasks.lead: Close b3 (TX registration) + b7 (CA producer license #)
tasks.detail: Day 10 of live consumer dialing with the gate at 0/7. Send the NPN + CA license # and the TX filing status — or write the one-line rule scoping who may be dialed until they clear.

tasks.lead: Name the day-10 verdict criteria before you get there
tasks.detail: The tranche closes Sep 15. Say now, in one line, what result would justify a third tranche — otherwise the decision gets made on a feeling and $200.

tasks.lead: Subscribe the V3 lead form to the "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Sheet
tasks.detail: Confirmed narrow diagnosis: n8n W1 ran clean, so the lead never arrived. Wire the form, then prove it with one real end-to-end submit.
Meta says 3 since Sep 5, the inbox has 2, the digest reads its own number. Pick one source of truth so cost-per-lead and cost-per-booked-call become computable before Sep 15.

tasks.lead: Rebuild meeting-ingest + cofounder sweep as LOCAL tasks
tasks.detail: The sweep fired on-cron at 00:33Z today and wrote nothing — fired-but-did-not-write again. Meeting data 20 days stale, dashboard 12 days at v15.17.
Down since Aug 27. Booked calls from real ad leads is the deciding metric for the tranche and it has never once been measured.

tasks.lead: Watch the V2 tranche daily to the Sep 15 line
tasks.detail: Track spend, lead attribution and the inbox-vs-Meta gap each edition; flag the moment the second half starts buying the same out-of-area result.

tasks.lead: Hold the compliance day-count visible every edition
tasks.detail: Day 10 today. It does not move off the front page until b3 and b7 close or a written dialing rule replaces them.

tasks.lead: Publish + verify the brief, take no outward action
tasks.detail: No lead contact, no campaign/geo/budget change, no compliance claim cleared, no spend — all of those are the founders’ calls.

done.what: AM live Gmail sweep (Sep 7 13:50Z → Sep 8 22:09Z) — read every watchdog run plus both lead captures and the Sep 8 digest.

Narrowed the lost-lead diagnosis: the 19:07Z run states n8n W1 Lead Ingest executed successfully — so it is a V3 form → Google Sheet mapping gap, not a workflow failure. Supersedes yesterday’s "n8n is dropping traffic" framing.
Spend read live: $2.07 on Sep 8, V2 $66.67 of $200 (day 5 of 10), lifetime $309.36; campaign ACTIVE, no pause limit near. Frankie paused the "8 doors" ad himself during edits.
Verified the cofounder lane fired on-cron 00:33:24Z today yet cofounder_log.json is still dated Sep 7 — lastRunAt advanced, artifact did not. Logged as the bridge signature, not a scheduler fault.

waiting.what: TOP — Frankie: narrow the campaign geo to licensed states, decide refer-out-or-drop on Nadine + Linda in writing, and close b3/b7 (day 10 at 0/7).
BLOCKER — Chitraksh: subscribe the V3 form to the "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Sheet and prove it with one live submit; then rebuild meeting-ingest + cofounder sweep as LOCAL tasks.
